_comment: Curated seed table of confirmed FCC User Manual PDFs for common perioperative devices. Each entry was hand-verified against the fcc.report filing page. Add new entries as devices are encountered; set verified:true after a clinician reviews the extracted facts.

devices.label: Medtronic Azure S/XT SR/DR MRI SureScan
devices.notes: Azure S SR, Azure S DR, Azure XT SR, Azure XT DR MRI SureScan. Dual-chamber and single-chamber MRI-conditional pacemakers.

devices.label: Medtronic Cobalt/Crome XT SR/DR/CRT-D MRI SureScan
devices.notes: Cobalt XT VR/DR MRI, Crome VR/DR MRI, Cobalt XT HF CRT-D MRI, Cobalt HF CRT-D MRI, Crome HF CRT-D MRI. 2023 generation.

devices.label: Medtronic Percepta/Serena/Solara CRT-P MRI SureScan
devices.notes: Percepta CRT-P, Percepta Quad CRT-P, Serena CRT-P, Serena Quad CRT-P, Solara CRT-P, Solara Quad CRT-P. All MRI SureScan.

devices.label: Medtronic Micra Leadless Pacemaker
devices.notes: Medtronic Micra leadless transcatheter pacemaker (filed under Covidien LLC, a Medtronic subsidiary). Covers Micra AV and Micra VR. 2023 filing.

devices.label: Abbott/SJM ICD Family (Gallant, Ellipse)
devices.notes: Abbott (formerly St. Jude Medical) ICD family. FCC ID covers multiple ICD models including Gallant and related devices. Updated 2024.

devices.label: Boston Scientific CRM 3300 Series (Resonate/Dynagen/Energen)
devices.notes: Boston Scientific CRM 3300 product family (2017 filing). Covers Resonate, Dynagen, Energen and related BSc ICD/CRT-D devices.

devices.label: Nevro HFX IPG3000 Spinal Cord Stimulator
devices.notes: Nevro HFX spinal cord stimulator IPG3000 (2022 generation). Prescriber/HCP manual selected (5885970) over patient manual. Includes 10 kHz therapy info.

devices.label: Nevro HFX IPG2000 Spinal Cord Stimulator
devices.notes: Nevro HFX spinal cord stimulator IPG2000 (2017 generation). URL is the filing page — scrape will find User Manual.
devices._note: No User Manual URL confirmed yet — will fallback to FCC scraper

devices.label: Dexcom G6 Transmitter
devices.notes: Dexcom G6 CGM transmitter. Communicates glucose to the G6 receiver or compatible smart device. No internal battery replacement.

devices.label: Dexcom G7 Transmitter
devices.notes: Dexcom G7 CGM transmitter/sensor (integrated design, 2023+). URL is the filing page — scrape will find User Manual.
devices._note: FCC filing page not loading during research — will fallback to FCC scraper

devices.label: Dexcom Stelo Transmitter
devices.notes: Dexcom Stelo OTC CGM transmitter (2024). Over-the-counter, no prescription required. Shares platform with G7.

devices.label: Omnipod 5 Automated Insulin Delivery System
devices.notes: Insulet Omnipod 5 tubeless insulin pump pod. Communicates with Dexcom G6/G7 for automated closed-loop dosing.

devices.label: Omnipod 5 Pod (alternate filing)
devices.notes: Insulet Omnipod 5 Pod (RBV029D). Alternate FCC filing for pod hardware variant.

devices.label: Medtronic Guardian Link Transmitter (MiniMed 600/700 series)
devices.notes: Medtronic Guardian Link CGM transmitter for MiniMed 600-series pumps (670G, 770G, 780G). Collects sensor glucose and transmits to insulin pump.

devices.label: Tandem t:slim Insulin Delivery System
devices.notes: Tandem Diabetes Care t:slim insulin pump (2012 original FCC filing). The t:slim X2 is a software/hardware revision of the same platform; no separate FCC filing found. Manual covers core pump operation.
